item.title: HTB: Sauna
item.description: Windows AD box, no credentials given. The website is running for a fictional bank called Egotistical Bank, and it’s the only initial foothold surface. What makes this box interesting is the AS-REP roasting step, a technique that often gets lumped in with Kerberoasting in tool menus, but the mechanism is completely different and worth understanding on its own. The escalation is clean: Winlogon autologon keys exposing a service account, that service account having DCSync rights.
